fields.title: Mode
fields.description:
Choose whether to add a fixed number of rows to the input table ("Additional"), independent of
the input table's row count; or to add rows to the table only in case there are less rows than
indicated ("At least"). The latter will not change the input table if there are already more rows
than specified in the corresponding field.

fields.title: Count
fields.description: Number of rows to add or minimum number of rows in the output table.

fields.title: RowID prefix
fields.description: Prefix for the RowIDs of newly added rows.

fields.title: Number (Float)
fields.description: Fill value for Float columns in newly added rows.

fields.title: Number (Integer)
fields.description: Fill value for Integer columns in newly added rows.

fields.title: String
fields.description: Fill value for String columns in newly added rows.
